[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended online resources for photography skills improvement include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Online Courses:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. **Udemy**: Offers a wide range of photography courses, from beginners to advanced levels. (Affordable, often on sale)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. **Coursera**: Partners with top universities to offer photography courses, such as "Photography Basics and Beyond" from Michigan State University. (Free, with optional paid certification)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. **Skillshare**: Provides a variety of photography courses, workshops, and classes, with a focus on creative and practical skills. (Subscription-based, with a free trial)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. **CreativeLive**: Live online workshops and classes taught by industry experts, covering various aspects of photography. (Free to watch live, with optional paid access to recorded classes)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. **KelbyOne**: Offers in-depth courses and tutorials on photography, lighting, and post-processing, taught by Scott Kelby and other experts. (Subscription-based)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Tutorials and Websites:**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. **YouTube Channels**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - **Tony Northrup**: Comprehensive tutorials and gear reviews.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - **Peter McKinnon**: Engaging tutorials and tips for beginners and advanced photographers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - **Jared Polin (FroKnowsPhoto)**: Fun, informative tutorials and gear reviews.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. **Digital Photography School**: A free online resource with tutorials, articles, and tips on various aspects of photography.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. **500px**: A community-driven platform with tutorials, articles, and inspiring photography.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. **B&H Photo**: Offers a range of free tutorials, articles, and workshops on various photography topics.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. **Cambridge in Colour**: A comprehensive online guide to photography, covering technical and creative aspects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. **Phlearn**: Free and paid tutorials on photography, Photoshop, and Lightroom.
